subject: Ciências
description_pt: Descrever e comunicar as alterações que ocorrem desde o nascimento em animais de diferentes meios terrestres ou aquáticos, inclusive o homem.

components.description_pt: Descrever mudanças do desenvolvimento que ocorrem desde o nascimento em animais terrestres
components.description_en: Describe developmental changes that occur from birth onward in terrestrial animals
components.cc_component_description: Identify examples of animals that produce offspring and describe parental care behaviors that aid survival

components.description_pt: Comunicar mudanças observadas no desenvolvimento animal em diferentes ambientes
components.description_en: Communicate observed changes in animal development across different environments
components.cc_component_description: Compare embryological development stages across different species to identify structural similarities

cc_matches.description: Adult plants and animals can have young. In many kinds of animals, parents and the offspring themselves engage in behaviors that help the offspring to survive.
Comparison of the embryological development of different species also reveals similarities that show relationships not evident in the fully-formed anatomy.
